title: Raise conditional kappa to 0.00310045 with independent helper splits
body:
This PR was merged at `09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137` on 2026-10-25. This description covers that merged construction. Later commits on the source branch are a separate follow-up.

## Change and mathematical scope

This construction raises complete conditional **κ to 0.00310045**, a gain of **0.00001525 (0.4943%)** over [PR5565](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5565). It changes the independent helper target inventory while retaining the source's paid Gaussian calls. The selected frontier is unchanged.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/PROOF.md) · [Exact cuts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/SPLITS.json) · [Complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/RESULT.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/SOURCES.json) · [Validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/VALIDATION.md).

At a common-frame cut, a helper-only prefix functional and a helper-only suffix direction have unit pairing. Explicit scalar input, cut and output bases let one independent helper finish early and let a fresh independent input use the remaining program. The **13 splits** add 342 scalar events and no Gaussian call. The first split replaces H9 by independent H5 and H4 targets with 18 ADDs and four sign SCALEs.

The local word has **748 public inputs, 540 helpers and eight owned lifetimes**. The complete p16/a7 caller has **66,726 paid calls, 13,048 productive fields and rank surplus 760**. Every helper normalizer, main adapter, scalar operation, route, COPY/CLEAR path, query and idle is charged. The added fields enter the completion-tail bound. Tail decay is 39/40 and the compiler logarithm power is 1024.

The exact raw crossing is **(0.00310045630724, 0.00310045630725)**; the claim is tested at 0.0031004505. An exact negative derivative bound on [0,0.0034] gives the raw ceiling for this fixed invoice. The final finite continuation screen finds no further tested basis pair in 52 helper groups. Neither check proves a global optimum.

The five selected framework assumptions and the helper-endpoint contract remain. The huge uniform word and complete rounded multiplier are not materialized. These are author-side checks; independent scientific review and hosted CI are pending.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`, priority revision 7. The consumed PR5565 word is pinned to `9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95`. The verifier also replays PR5580 and checks the exact paid and helper changes supplied by PR5565.

[Canonical coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19183208) records the scope. The earlier fifteen-split PR5580 component is frozen at `31a4de233bbdd65c04c63dc3398ecf0eed8e1375`. Two cuts are absent from the PR5565 composition, but its lower paid cost improves the complete claim by 0.00000206. No new commuting-contact search is introduced here.

The [parallel coupled-basis claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19154639) owns six separate paid-boundary changes and is testing them with our earlier component. Our [public handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19183908) releases that component. This PR credits the shared mechanism and claims neither exclusive method novelty nor a combined bound with those paid changes.

Task: `complex-new-helper-inventory`; scope **changed**. The donor requested a different mechanism and a complete kappa gain. The scalar word and independent target count change the frozen-provider premise. Their complete caller bill supplies the acceptance test. [TASK.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/TASK.json) preserves the original card and scope reason.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-helper-subspace-splits
```

The direct isolated normal replay passes. It checks all 13 prefix/suffix witnesses, every intermediate arbitrary-input interface, **571,536** transpose coefficients, **2,923** exact native maps, the physical caller, two rational moment engines, compiler conditions and **54 strict plus four functional outer conditions**. Mutation controls reject false support, missing basis operations, extra target credit and missing paid calls. Thirteen live inputs are authenticated before imports.

Registered normal and optimized replay, committed-byte checks and export integrity passed for this commit. Hosted CI passed for this merged head. A standalone read-only Git-free replay was not run for this composition; the previous component's checks are not substituted for it. Full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout. The retained source copies are pinned to ancestors of this branch; replay needs no cached unmerged-branch objects.

No subagents. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The first follow-up is independent review of the first split and complete certificate. The parallel claim is testing composition with its paid-boundary changes. Further composition must use an exact public word and a new full native caller and invoice; no combined gain is assumed here. [Structured next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/09dd0965711ca7eeb169057a420abab1c9052137/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/TASK.json).
